alt: 兩個人互相配合做壞事，一人在門口替同伴把風，另一人趁店主沒注意，偷偷把商品藏進袋子。
scene_prompt: 狼狽為奸 means two people colluding to do wrong. Fictional modern small shop with THREE adults. One dishonest adult by the door keeps lookout and exchanges a knowing glance with his accomplice. The second dishonest adult discreetly hides a small plain packaged item from the shelf into a tote bag while the innocent shopkeeper at back is turned toward arranging stock. The two conspirators' complementary roles and eye contact are the focal point. No security systems, lock picking, detailed theft technique, weapons, brand products or text. Show wrongdoing as sly and disapproved, not glamorous, no children participating and no violence.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper.
